card.name: Words just before a noun in clinical lists
card.fires_on: Fires on the word or number that ends a qualifier right before the thing it modifies, such as "unstable" before heart failure, the end of a day range before "days", or "duration" before "of their effect". It is seen in drug-label warnings and dosing text.

modes.label: Condition qualifier
modes.description: An adjective like unstable or quiescent placed before a disease name.
modes.example: worsening or<< unstable>> congestive heart failure, or serious vent

modes.label: Number ending a range
modes.description: The last digit of a time or day range, just before the word hours or days.
modes.example: 1-1/2 to <<2>> hours before UVA exposure with some low

modes.label: Noun in a paired phrase
modes.description: A noun like duration that finishes a pair and is followed by "of".
modes.example: enhance the magnitude and<< duration>> of their effect. Acetazol
